B. THE SCORING FORMULA (marker → pillar → PureScore)
① Marker risk r_i (two-sided clinical bands)
R_k^mark = ( Σ ŵ_i r_i^γ / Σ ŵ_i )^(1/γ)
③ Critical override (a red biomarker → critical)
R_total = ( Σ W_k R_k^δ / Σ W_k )^(1/δ)
be averaged away by healthy pillars
sleep debt heals in days; CAC ~ permanent
Defaults: φ=0.60 γ=3 δ=2 ρ=0.20 R_crit=0.60 cap=40 · zone cuts r=0.15 / 0.50 · full spec: docs/purescore/ (Docs 03 & 04)
